preconditions.description: x is an integer representing the required sharpness of the matrix.

postconditions.description: The output n is a positive integer.
The matrix size n squared is at least as large as the required sharpness x.

postconditions.expression: any(all(A[i][j] == A[n - i - 1][j] and A[i][j] == A[i][n - j - 1] for j in range(n)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: There exists a clear symmetrical matrix A of size n with sharpness x.

postconditions.expression: sum(sum(A[i][j] for j in range(n)) for i in range(n)) == x
postconditions.description: The total number of ones in the matrix A is exactly x.
